CustomField.description: The balance row this request draws on, stamped when it is approved. Gives every Leave Balance record a related list of the requests that consumed it. Resolved from owner, leave type and year - the same key the deduction uses - so the link and the arithmetic can never point at different rows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The leave balance this request was deducted from. Set automatically on approval.
CustomField.label: Leave Balance
